claim: A curated set of public antimicrobial peptides can be reprioritized via manufacturability-aware scoring to produce a smaller, safer shortlist.
design_strategy: Reuse known AMP scaffolds, then rank by manufacturability and documented safety/solubility context before assay planning.
success_criteria: At least 10 candidate cards are fully curated in a single campaign folder.
Each manual scoring run emits a data-governance preflight report.
rejection_criteria: Candidates with severe sequence integrity or governance violations.
Candidates with unresolved severe assay safety concerns.
